entities.summary: James Oliver Rigney Jr., known by his pen name Robert Jordan, was an American author of epic fantasy. He is best known as the author of The Wheel of Time series, which comprises 14 books and a prequel novel. The series is among the highest selling book series of all time, with 90 million copies sold. In his earlier career he became one of several writers to produce original Conan the Barbarian novels; his are considered by fans to be some of the best of the non-Robert E. Howard efforts. Robert Jordan was the most well-known of several pen names he used, adopting different monikers for different genres.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a renowned author of epic fantasy, Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time series has sold over 90 million copies worldwide, making it one of the highest-selling book series of all time. His work has had a significant impact on popular culture and the fantasy genre as a whole.
